countryCodes.description: Keep places in these two-letter countries, e.g. FR, US, JP. Empty means all countries.
countryCodes.title: Country codes

enrichDetails.description: Adds Plus Code, rating histogram, photos, amenities, price range, booking links, closure state and hotel details. Turn it off for the fastest, smallest runs using list-feed data only.
enrichDetails.title: Fetch full place details

excludeCategories.description: Drop places whose primary or secondary category contains any of these words.
excludeCategories.title: Exclude categories

hasPhone.description: Keep only places with a published phone number.
hasPhone.title: Must have a phone number

hasWebsite.description: Keep only places with a published website.
hasWebsite.title: Must have a website

includeCategories.description: Keep places whose primary or secondary category contains any of these words.
includeCategories.title: Include categories

includeClosed.description: When disabled, permanently closed places are dropped. This needs full place details.
includeClosed.title: Include permanently closed places

language.description: Google Maps interface language. Names, categories, addresses and hours are localized.
language.title: Language

listUrls.description: Public Google Maps shared-list links (google.com/maps/placelists/list/...) or Maps search URLs. Short maps.app.goo.gl links are resolved automatically.
listUrls.title: Shared list or Maps URLs

location.description: Optional city, neighborhood or region appended to every query when it is not already mentioned.
location.title: Location

maxRating.description: Drop places with a higher rating.
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

maxResults.description: Maximum places to return per query or list. The public feed may expose fewer; lists are returned up to the source window.
maxResults.title: Max results

minRating.description: Drop places with a lower rating or no published rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Drop places with fewer reviews or no published review count.
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: Use 'topList' for ranked queries like 'Top hotels in Paris'. Use 'listUrl' for a shared Google Maps list link or a Maps search URL.
mode.title: Mode

nameFilter.description: Keep only places whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
nameFilter.title: Name contains

openNow.description: Keep only places Google currently marks as open.
openNow.title: Open now

queries.description: Ranked list queries. For example: 'Top hotels in Paris', 'Best coffee in Brooklyn', 'Things to do in Tokyo'. Each query is scraped separately.
queries.title: Queries

title: Google Maps Top List & Ranked Places Extractor
